building 10-course breakfast 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
set.seed(40)

breakfast <- c("eggs", "bacon", "sausages", "toast")
b_courses <- tibble()

for (course in seq_len(10)) {
  b_item <- sample(breakfast, size = 1)
  b_num <- sample(1:5,1)
  current_row <- tibble(
    Breakfast_item = b_item,
    Number = b_num
  )
  b_courses <- b_courses |> bind_rows(current_row)
}
gt(b_courses)
```
binomial calculations 
```{r}
count_p_flowers <- rbinom(n = 1000, size = 200, prob = 0.6)
print(sum(count_p_flowers >= 125) / length(count_p_flowers))
```
